The '''Eternal Furnace''' was a giant [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pool used by the [[Aurean Glassworkers Guild]] for their most audacious and important projects. Apprentices to the guild spent many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] just developing the tolerances necessary to work in the presence of such fiery heat, and the most incredible works of glass known in the galaxy came from the [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]] who worked with the Furnace.
